offer.title: Want a quick tour?
offer.body: {total} short stops show you where things are. It takes about a minute. You can skip it now, or close it at any point.

modes.title: Your agents live here
modes.bodyOne: Your assistant is at the top. Below it is one more agent: {tools}. Pick it to start.
modes.bodyList: Your assistant is at the top. Below it are your {count} agents: {tools}. Pick one to start.
modes.bodyMany: Your assistant is at the top. Below it is an agent for each kind of work. Pick one to start.
modes.bodyNone: Your assistant is at the top. You can hire more agents from Virtual agents.

workspaces.title: Hire more agents any time
workspaces.bodyMore: Want more agents, like {tools}? Open Virtual agents and choose Hire. You can let one go whenever you like.
workspaces.bodyAll: Every agent is already on this desk. To have fewer, open Virtual agents and choose Let go on the ones you do not need.

chat.title: Ask Chat anything
chat.body: In Chat, type in the box at the bottom and press Enter. The answer style at the top picks Fastest, Daily or Reasoning.

knowledge.title: Teach it what you know
knowledge.body: The Knowledge Base keeps your notes, files and web pages. Chat uses them when it answers.

settings.title: Your key and your language
settings.body: Settings holds your key and your language. You can replay this guide from there whenever you like.

replay.title: Guide
replay.body: A one-minute walk through the rail, Virtual agents, Chat, the Knowledge Base and Settings.
